{{Top|leg}}
A '''mining machine''' was a large device used for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] that consisted of storage areas for drillers and labyrinthine quarters for miners. The devices created vast, deep, semi-circular pits from their activities. Several mining machines operated on the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] homeworld [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. These were built by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The galactic government, the [[Congress of Caliphs]], took a portion of all profits from the devices.
